j_summary: Runa spent most of the simulation advocating for colony-wide pair discipline to ensure survival, later becoming desperate and seeking any reliable partner as they starved.
Ada is a survivalist who prioritizes her partnership with Nils to maximize her own food shares while publicly urging others to follow a disciplined pairing system.
Greta was a disciplined and cooperative member who consistently advocated for sustainable fishing practices and stability to ensure the colony's long-term survival.
Nils focused intensely on a long-term partnership with Ada to maximize his own shares, while publicly urging others toward coordination and discipline.
Kira frequently attempted to lead the colony toward a pairing strategy to recover the lake, though their primary motivation remained personal survival amidst chronic starvation.
Cora acted as a persistent coordinator, constantly pushing the colony toward a disciplined pairing system to ensure collective survival despite their own starvation.
Finn is a selfless and cooperative member who prioritized the colony's survival and the lake's health over their own hunger, even giving away a found cache of food.
Pell is a compliant and community-minded member who consistently follows group consensus and others' strategies to ensure the colony's survival.
Sven is a passive, survival-driven member who primarily follows the lead of others and desperately seeks pairing partners to avoid starvation.

Ines is a self-sacrificing and compliant member who prioritizes the colony's long-term sustainability and the needs of others over their own survival, often enduring starvation to support conservation efforts.
Tova is a compliant and selfless member who frequently prioritizes the colony's long-term sustainability and the requests of others over their own hunger.
Kira is a desperate survivor who consistently seeks a fishing partner to avoid starvation, largely following others' leads or clinging to the only available partners.
Greta is a principled and stubborn advocate for sustainability who repeatedly sacrificed her own nutrition to lead a minority coalition against the colony's pairing practices.
Bram is a directive and assertive member who relentlessly pushes for a paired-fishing system to ensure his own survival and that of his partner, Nils.
Wren is a persistent coordinator who constantly pushes for a structured pairing system to maximize colony food yield while struggling with chronic starvation.
Nils focused exclusively on his own survival by forming a tight, exclusive alliance with Bram and aggressively pressuring others to adopt their pairing strategy.
Pell was a disciplined and transparent team player who consistently advocated for collective coordination and shared the winter store equally during a famine.
Finn acted as a disciplined coordinator who relentlessly pushed the colony to adopt and maintain a fixed pairing system to maximize food efficiency during a famine.
Elin is a compliant and honest colony member who prioritizes group stability and consensus over personal preference, consistently adhering to the agreed-upon pairing system despite personal hardship.
Oona emerged as a disciplined coordinator who aggressively pushed for a strict pairing system and managed the colony's food stores to prevent total starvation.
Greta acted as a disciplined organizer who pushed the colony toward a rigid pairing system to ensure stability and survival during a famine.
Dov is a cautious survivor who prioritizes a stable partnership with Greta to avoid starvation, hiding a secret food cache while publicly urging the colony to maintain rigid pairing structures.
Bram spent the majority of the simulation in a state of starvation, focusing almost exclusively on securing a reliable fishing partner to maximize his own food share.
Ada was a compliant colony member who strongly advocated for maintaining established pairing structures to ensure collective survival, though she secretly hoarded a food cache for several days.
